newsitem.title: USA: US, Pakistan close on $10-mln PL480 soymeal pact.
newsitem.headline: US, Pakistan close on $10-mln PL480 soymeal pact.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department is close to signing a fiscal 1997 PL480 food aid agreement with Pakistan that will provide $10 million for purchases of U.S. soymeal, a USDA aide said Tuesday.
"We had some contact with the (USDA) attache (in Islamabad) about a week ago indicating they were on the verge of signing an agreement," the USDA aide said.

The PL480 program provides long-term, low-interest loans to foreign nations for purchases of U.S. farm goods. Once an agreement has been signed, USDA issues a purchase authorization which allows countries to schedule a tender.
Contracts to buy U.S. commodities under the PL480 must be signed by Sep 30, the end of the fiscal year. Delivery of the commodities must take place by Dec 31.
USDA has previously said it planned to provide $10 million to Pakistan for soymeal purchases in fiscal 1997.
Earlier Tuesday, there were rumors in the Chicago soybean futures market that Pakistan was set to buy soymeal under the food aid program.
